import csv
import io

rows = [['name', 'age'], ['ada', '36'], ['bob', '24']]

output = io.StringIO()
writer = csv.writer(output)
writer.writerows(rows)
csv_string = output.getvalue()

input_ = io.StringIO(csv_string)
reader = csv.DictReader(input_)
ages = {row['name']: row['age'] for row in reader}
